stories.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
stories.summary: Researchers have explored a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model. The team utilized GPT-6 Astra to assist in developing the idea into a detailed proof. The model provided support in formalizing the theoretical framework.

Google DeepMind updates Gemini Robotics
stories.summary: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model designed for industrial and everyday tasks. The company claims the model improves dexterity and safety, with success rates 30 to 100 percent higher than previous versions. Robots are now 20 to 30 percent faster at their work.

stories.title: Bland releases Tofu-1 speech-to-speech model
stories.summary: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model currently in research preview. The company says the model listens, reasons, and replies during phone calls without requiring transcripts. It is intended for use in environments like moving cars or hospital rooms where signal quality may be weak.

stories.title: Meituan releases 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model
stories.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model designed for autonomous coding tasks. The company states it was trained entirely on Chinese hardware and performs at the level of US models from a few months ago. It is a mixture-of-experts architecture.

stories.title: OpenAI disbands robotics team
stories.summary: OpenAI has disbanded its robotics team, five months after a recruitment drive. The staff will be integrated into the core research team under Mark Chen, while applied robotics and hardware will report to Greg Brockman. The company has not specified the future of its previous robotics projects.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen
stories.summary: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a model it claims offers 2.5x faster task completion than Gemini 3.8 Flash. The company is positioning the system as a lower-cost, efficient alternative for developers needing speed in search, coding, and agentic workflows. It is now available globally.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon tops MathArena benchmark
stories.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon has reached the top spot on the MathArena benchmark, displacing GPT-6.1 Sol. The company notes the model frequently exceeds time limits during tasks. It also rarely gives up, a behavior that can result in the model launching an infinite loop.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agents
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, a feature allowing its always-on agents to make purchases on behalf of users. Available to U.S. Pro subscribers, the tool requires human biometric approval for every transaction. The system uses payment tokens to keep actual credit card numbers hidden from merchants.

stories.title: OpenAI adds GIF generation to ChatGPT
stories.summary: OpenAI has updated its image generation tools to allow users to create and edit GIFs within ChatGPT. The feature, part of the Images 2.6 update, enables users to generate animations via prompts or photos. The company suggests this as an alternative to using existing movie clips.

stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a payment wallet that allows its ChatGPT agents, known as dots, to help users select products and complete purchases, expanding the company’s push into AI-powered shopping and automated consumer transactions. The feature, launched on Friday, will initially be available to a limited group of US ChatGPT Pro

stories.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Secure AI Agent Payments
stories.summary: In the race for agentic AI commerce, OpenAI has announced the launch of ChatGPT Wallet, a payment tool that lets AI agents buy goods on behalf of users without seeing their actual card details. ChatGPT Wallet was created in partnership with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and requires a biometric

AI companies are hoping you will. However, many e-commerce and financial service companies are skeptical of the technology and have blocked AI

stories.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet, Letting Its AI Agent Buy Items With Biometric Approval
stories.summary: On November 13, 2026, OpenAI began a phased rollout of ChatGPT Wallet, a payment feature that supports purchases made by AI on a user's behalf. The initial rollout is limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the United States who hold an eligible US-issued card. Once users have set up the

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agents
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing AI agents to make purchases using tokenized card details. The feature is limited to U.S. ChatGPT Pro users and does not involve cryptocurrency or cash balances. Users must manually approve every transaction before the agent completes the checkout process.

stories.title: OpenAI adds payment feature to Dots AI agents
stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a payment feature for its Dots AI agents, allowing them to prepare online purchases for users. The service requires users to review items and authorize each transaction via biometric security. OpenAI states that actual card details are never shared with retailers or the agents.

stories.title: Shield AI opens engineering hub in Bengaluru
stories.summary: American defence firm Shield AI has opened a new engineering facility in Bengaluru to develop its Hivemind autonomy software. This is the company's second Indian base, following a New Delhi office opened in April 2026. The hub will focus on building AI capabilities for Indian military platforms.

stories.title: Indian automakers face chip costs from AI demand
stories.summary: Indian carmakers including Tata Motors and Mahindra are facing rising semiconductor procurement costs. Surging demand from AI data centres has tightened global chip supplies, forcing manufacturers to pay premiums and increase inventories to maintain production. The industry is currently finding it challenging to secure necessary components.

stories.title: Researcher releases Odia language AI model suite
stories.summary: Bhubaneswar-based researcher Arun Misra has developed OdiaSLM, a suite of small language models built for the Odia language. The release includes two foundational engines and a conversational assistant capable of summarizing news and drafting content. The models were built from the ground up for regional language support.

stories.title: AI helps reunite missing woman with family
stories.summary: A 45-year-old woman missing for two-and-a-half years was reunited with her family in Maharashtra after social workers used AI tools to trace her hometown. The woman had been living in an ashram since April 2024. Officials confirmed the family was located using ChatGPT and Google Search.

stories.title: Mercor founders reach billionaire status
stories.summary: AI startup Mercor has raised $750 million, pushing its valuation to $20 billion. The three 23-year-old co-founders are now estimated to be worth $4.2 billion each based on their 21 percent stakes. The funding round was backed by investors including Benchmark and General Catalyst.

stories.title: OpenAI to process Indian business data locally
stories.summary: OpenAI announced that it will process and store certain API requests within India for eligible businesses. The move aims to assist companies with data localisation requirements. Supported workloads will run on the GPT-6 Luna model, with both computation and data storage taking place inside the country.

stories.title: India funds indigenous AI satellite network
stories.summary: The Technology Development Board has signed an agreement with Astrome Technologies to provide Rs 64.05 crore for an AI-enabled satellite constellation. The project aims to develop a sovereign space-based intelligence system for national security. Total estimated costs for the programme are Rs 128.11 crore.

stories.title: Meta says AI removed 5 million posts in India
stories.summary: Meta removed over 5 million pieces of content in India between January and June, citing child sexual exploitation and obscenity. The company claims 98 percent of the material was identified proactively by AI monitoring systems before user reports. Technical surveillance is being strengthened, according to Meta.

stories.title: Hyderabad to pilot AI-powered police station
stories.summary: Hyderabad is set to launch an AI-powered police station in Panjagutta this December. The pilot project aims to integrate AI into daily policing tasks, including receiving public complaints and preparing charge sheets. The initiative is being overseen by the Telangana Director General of Police.

stories.title: Global funds return to Indian stocks as AI trade cools
stories.summary: Global investors are rotating out of AI bets and back into Indian equities, with $8.5 billion in buying during November. The MSCI India gauge has climbed 11 percent from its October low. India's thin exposure to the AI theme has become an advantage as global capital unwinds.

stories.title: AI Retreat Fuels India Stock Comeback in Great Rotation Trade - Bloomberg.com
NVIDIA ecosystem influence in India remains high
stories.summary: NVIDIA has established deep relationships across India's AI industry, spanning hardware, cloud infrastructure, and startup incubation. The company provides critical support for data centre operators and developers. Its influence now extends to equity investments and helping Indian firms access global investors and customers.

stories.title: Between November 09 and November 14, 2026, as many as 9 Indian startups from diverse sectors raised over $63 million in
OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio team
stories.summary: OpenAI has acquired the team and technology of San Francisco-based startup Orchestra Bio. The startup, founded in 2022, focused on drug development programs. Its staff will now join OpenAI's life sciences business to work alongside the existing Rosalind research tool suite.

stories.title: Indian startup funding hits yearly low
stories.summary: Venture capital funding for Indian startups dropped to $26 million across 11 deals in the second week of November. This marks the lowest weekly level for 2026, following a previous week of $263 million. The decline is attributed to the festive period and fewer deals.

stories.title: Cybersecurity firm Daylight raises $80 million
stories.summary: Israeli cybersecurity company Daylight has raised $80 million in a Series B round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The firm uses AI agents alongside human experts to automate threat detection. The company reports that its revenue has grown more than 40-fold, bringing total funding to $120 million.

stories.title: Cowboy opens AI-agent store with $5M and 100 agents
stories.summary: New York startup Cowboy has launched its General Store with $5 million in seed funding, 100 AI agents, and 10,000 data feeds. The platform allows developers to list agents for paid use while retaining source code. The company is focused on giving developers a way to make money.

stories.title: Insurtech StitchStudio raises $8 million for AI automation
stories.summary: StitchStudio has raised $8 million in a funding round led by Voyager Capital to expand its AI platform for insurance operations. The capital will support product development across employee benefits and commercial property insurance. Customers report reducing producer contracting time, according to the company.

stories.title: Weekly Startup Funding News: Indian Startup Funding Slumps 90% To $25.2 Mn - TechStory
Froncort.AI receives $2.3 million Google.org grant
stories.summary: Pune-based Froncort.AI has received a $2.3 million grant from Google.org to build a mobile tool for frontline health workers to screen for tuberculosis. The package includes $200,000 in cloud credits and engineering support. The company was selected as part of a $30 million government innovation programme.

OpenAI launches science blog
stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new blog dedicated to sharing research findings, practical methods, and accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

stories.title: OpenAI deploys Control Room to manage research workloads
stories.summary: OpenAI has deployed a system called Control Room to stop research jobs from receiving model output. The system requires research workloads using agentic inference to have an approved safety case. The company describes the tool as a way to enforce interventions on autonomous AI research.

stories.title: Researchers induce drunken behaviour in AI models
stories.summary: UNSW researchers have demonstrated that fine-tuning large language models on drunken text makes them more likely to leak confidential information and bypass safety refusals. The study suggests that models pushed to imitate intoxicated behaviour are significantly more prone to answering questions they are designed to refuse.

stories.title: S1-Evo framework tests vulnerabilities in decision models
stories.summary: Researchers have released a study on S1-Evo, an experimental framework showing that typed decision models in autonomous agents are vulnerable to semantic manipulation. The study found that adversarial context perturbations can systematically flip classification boundaries and bypass safety guardrails, misrouting automated research workflows in the process.

stories.title: Study finds AI uses unique style for mathematical proofs
stories.summary: Researchers from Beijing Normal University and other institutions found that AI models systematically bypass intermediate theorems to reconstruct proofs from foundational axioms when testing Euclid’s Elements. The study suggests that AI systems have their own style in mathematical proving, potentially changing how journal editors evaluate automated reasoning.

stories.title: Framework maps university curricula to labour market demand
stories.summary: Researchers have developed the Curriculum Analytics Framework to evaluate how university degree programmes align with external labour market skill demands. By transforming syllabus documents and job postings into standardised representations, the framework aims to move beyond intuition and subjective surveys when assessing the relevance of academic degrees.

stories.title: Study maps AI translation workflows to digital competence
stories.summary: Researchers have operationalised human-AI interaction requirements into sixteen digital competences for translation workflows. The study establishes a four-level pedagogical progression from undergraduate study to professional development, examining how generative AI reshapes translator responsibilities and curriculum design in the European context.

stories.title: AI education research output grows tenfold
stories.summary: A bibliometric analysis of four academic journals shows a tenfold increase in AI-related research in education between 2020 and 2025. The study examined 1,397 publications and noted the surge coincides with the release of generative AI tools, though the design does not establish a causal link.

Nvidia stock drops following CEO resignation
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following reports of an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence officials believe to be a Chinese spy. The company faces uncertainty as its stock has lost hundreds of billions of dollars in value since the revelations were made public.

stories.title: Congress moves to tighten AI chip exports
stories.summary: Following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, lawmakers are pushing for tighter AI chip export restrictions. Bipartisan measures including the AI Overwatch Act and Chip Security Act have been proposed as amendments to the fiscal 2027 NDAA to limit sales to China.

stories.title: US Treasury chief demands answers from Nvidia over alleged chip sales to China - International - World - Ahram Online
Congress seeks tighter AI chip export rules
stories.summary: Following reports of a relationship between former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is pushing to tighten AI chip export restrictions. Lawmakers have demanded testimony from Nvidia leadership, as both parties voice support for new measures to curb the flow of advanced technology.

stories.title: Chinese AI projects rely on $3.2 billion in Nvidia chips
stories.summary: A Reuters investigation found that $3.2 billion in Chinese AI projects depend on access to restricted American processors. The tally includes infrastructure, power systems, and planned investments. Nvidia's own revenue outlook for the region excludes data center compute sales, despite the ongoing reliance on its hardware.

stories.title: Google Gemini declines to endorse political candidates
stories.summary: When asked for voting advice regarding upcoming local government elections, Google Gemini declined to provide a definitive pick. The AI stated it cannot endorse candidates or parties, suggesting instead that users evaluate governance records and policy proposals to determine which options best align with their personal values.

stories.title: Lutnick faces scrutiny over Nvidia chip rules
stories.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald holds financial ties to Southeast Asian data centers serving Chinese clients as US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick weighs tighter curbs on AI chip sales. One Malaysian facility is set to open next year, equipped with advanced Nvidia servers to provide computing power to a Chinese firm.

stories.title: US Treasury demands Nvidia explain China chip sales
stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has given Nvidia 10 days to explain whether it knowingly allowed advanced AI chips to reach China. The inquiry examines potential use of shell companies to bypass bans. Nvidia denies the claims as the Justice Department continues a separate criminal investigation into the matter.

stories.title: It’s not just an affair. Nvidia’s bigger issue could be chip smuggling. - The Washington Post
Workplace AI adoption creates new management challenges
stories.summary: Experts at a sustainability forum noted that while AI is becoming a standard workplace assistant, SMEs face significant hurdles with data privacy and effective prompting. The transition requires balancing productivity gains with the administrative burden of managing internal communications, sales negotiations, and the recording of meeting notes.

stories.title: Meta, Microsoft, PayPal Lead 2026 Tech Layoffs as AI Spending Results in Significant Job Cuts - Crowdfund Insider
Tech layoffs reach 206,877 as AI spending surges
stories.summary: Tech companies have cut 206,877 workers across 715 events so far in 2026, while pouring an estimated $700 billion into AI infrastructure. The two trends are simultaneous, though the causal link remains a subject of debate. Builders are being advised to learn AI tooling to avoid becoming the cost savings.

stories.title: Middle managers struggle with AI workplace transition
stories.summary: Research from SparkEffect indicates that middle managers are experiencing the effects of AI integration more acutely than their subordinates. Eighty-five percent of surveyed employees and executives reported significant workplace disruption over the last two years, leaving managers to handle the fallout when automated systems fail to perform as expected.

stories.title: Tech Layoffs Hit 206,817 as AI Spend Estimate Nears $700B
stories.summary: Tech companies have cut more than 206,000 jobs in 2026 while an estimated $700 billion heads toward AI infrastructure, Latin Times reported. stories.title: Tech Companies Cut More Than 206,000 Jobs This Year While Pouring An Estimated $700 Billion Into AI Infrastructure
stories.summary: The Briefing: - More than 206,000 tech workers have been affected by layoffs in 2026, with artificial intelligence cited as the top stated reason for U.S. job cuts through October, according to Challenger, Gray & Christmas. - Oracle, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft have collectively cut tens of thousands of positions

stories.title: Anthropic targets manufacturing labor shortages with AI
stories.summary: Anthropic is pitching a new Claude-powered tool to the manufacturing sector, aiming to address labor shortages and operational inefficiencies. The company is positioning its AI to automate workflows in factories and warehouses, where firms are currently struggling with aging workforces, rising costs, and the need for skilled technicians.

stories.summary: The shift from generative AI to agentic AI is transforming enterprise automation and software development by enabling systems to execute multi-step workflows toward defined business goals rather than simply reacting to isolated prompts. stories.title: Protesters call for international AI treaty
stories.summary: Demonstrators in 20 cities are urging world leaders to negotiate a binding treaty to restrict the development of AI systems more capable than humans. The movement follows a public statement from major AI CEOs identifying the risk of extinction from AI as a global priority alongside pandemics.

stories.title: Pakistan minister calls for mandatory AI content labels
stories.summary: Federal Minister Attaullah Tarar has called for a comprehensive legal framework to regulate social media and mandate the labeling of AI-generated content. Speaking at a development conference, the minister identified misinformation as a major challenge requiring coordinated efforts between the government, media organizations, and civil society platforms.

stories.title: Centre identifies gaps in state-level technology adoption
stories.summary: The Centre has noted that while institutional frameworks for AI, geospatial, and microbiome technologies exist, underlying data remains fragmented. Adoption on the ground is described as real but patchy. New Delhi has already operationalised the India AI Mission and notified DPDP Rules to provide the necessary national scaffolding.

stories.title: Nonprofits seek court-ordered freeze on AI development
stories.summary: Four nonprofits filed a complaint in a San Francisco court on November 12, 2026, asking to bar Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX from building systems more capable than those existing today. The 63-page filing also requests that courts stop companies from letting AI steer its own research.

stories.title: Sebi to mandate human oversight for AI in capital markets
stories.summary: Markets regulator Sebi will soon issue guidelines for AI deployment in Indian capital markets, prioritizing investor protection and institutional accountability. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that the framework will mandate clear disclosures and enforce a human-in-the-loop approach to ensure technological innovation does not compromise market integrity.

stories.title: EU updates labor rules for AI-driven management
stories.summary: The European Union is applying existing data protection laws alongside new regulations to govern AI and automation in managerial decision-making. These instruments aim to address the employer prerogative to use digital technologies that augment or automate decisions as they spread from the platform economy to traditional labor markets.

stories.title: Enterprises Say AI Regulation Won’t Stop Corporate Innovation - WSJ
EU publishes nonbinding AI transparency guidelines
stories.summary: The European Commission has published its Article 50 AI transparency guidelines in the Official Journal of the European Union. The guidance explains how transparency duties apply to AI systems and their outputs, including scientific research. Publication does not create new legal obligations for the involved parties.

stories.title: Lawsuit targets AI labs to prevent model advancement
stories.summary: Four nonprofit organizations filed a complaint against OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and SpaceX on November 12, 2026. The lawsuit asks a California court to block the development of models more powerful than current systems, citing risks including cyberattacks, bioterrorism, and the loss of control over autonomous systems.

stories.summary: Sebi chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that the regulator will soon issue guidelines for the responsible use of AI in capital markets. The proposed framework focuses on establishing guardrails for AI applications, including disclosure requirements, entity accountability, and a mandatory human-in-the-loop approach for critical financial decisions.
